readLogs.sql:
SELECT timestamp,id,log_attributes['function_id'] AS function_id,log_attributes['execution_id'] AS execution_id,log_attributes['deployment_id'] AS deployment_id,JSONExtractString(event_message,'stage') AS stage,JSONExtractString(event_message,'railwayOperation') AS railway_operation,JSONExtractRaw(event_message,'railwayHttpStatus') AS railway_http_status,JSONExtractRaw(event_message,'railwayGraphqlCodes') AS railway_graphql_codes,JSONExtractString(event_message,'reason') AS reason
FROM logs
WHERE source='function_logs' AND event_message LIKE '%STORAGE_RENEWAL_FAILED_INSPECT_PROVIDER_STATE%' AND JSONExtractUInt(event_message,'diagnosticVersion')=1
ORDER BY timestamp ASC LIMIT 20
readLogs.interpretation: Accept fixed whitelisted stage/status/code/reason only. Bind function_id/execution_id/deployment/version to the scheduled run; missing fields or no rows are not proof of health. Discover attribute key names narrowly if needed, never dump log_attributes or headers.

readDatabase.cronSql: SELECT runid,jobid,status,start_time,end_time FROM cron.job_run_details WHERE jobid IN (1,2,3) AND start_time >= '2026-10-23T18:59:00Z'::timestamptz AND start_time < '2026-10-23T19:25:00Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY start_time ASC LIMIT 6
readDatabase.committedResultsSql: SELECT requested_at,mode,http_status,result->>'state' AS state FROM storage_renewal_ops.requests WHERE requested_at >= '2026-10-23T18:59:00Z'::timestamptz AND requested_at < '2026-10-23T19:25:00Z'::timestamptz ORDER BY requested_at ASC LIMIT 4
readDatabase.limits: failed transactions can leave no committed requests; bind cron failure and Edge execution, never infer success from absent rows

credentials: Use supported existing protected Management access. No CLI auto-refresh, secret readback, new issue/revoke, browser cookie/profile/CDP extraction or session copying. If new environment needs actual personal login/MFA, ask only for that login.

interpretation.RAILWAY_FETCH with null status: transport/timeout path; inspect provider availability before touching tokens
interpretation.RAILWAY_RESPONSE_PARSE with HTTP401/403: current project token access path; confirm exact revoked/expired/scope fact before proposing replacement
interpretation.KEY_MATCH: public/private JWK mismatch; verify protected equality before any key change
interpretation.VARIABLES_VALIDATE or TOKEN_VERIFY: exact target or stored-token verification mismatch; preserve current references and inspect narrow fields
interpretation.STORAGE_PROBE or APPLICATION_READINESS: use corresponding provider status/readiness result; do not restore exposed credentials

afterObservedFailure: Report the exact fixed failure branch and confidence; any credential/IAM/product/schedule repair still requires explicit separate authorization.
afterObservedSuccess: Report observed recovery with expiry/deployment/readiness evidence from the existing run; do not assert the discarded historical exception is recovered.
reasonNoLocalScheduledFollowup: User will continue on another environment from Oct24 and this local session is unavailable; existing Supabase jobs run independently, read result there.
manualInvocationRestrictionScope: No additional calls: a single direct read-only check was already used for the user request to identify failure immediately. Never use renew/renew-now or the DB invoke wrapper.
